spec_features.spec_quote: give_up is an explicit tool. We want abandonment to be a measurable, first-class action
spec_features.evidence: Prompt line GIVE_UP_LINE (agent.py:48-49) included when cfg.expose_give_up_tool (agent.py:156-157). Dispatched in _dispatch_tool agent.py:140-141 -> env.give_up (env.py:174-177) which sets self.state.done=True. Loop checks env.state.done at agent.py:215-218 and sets gave_up=True / stop_reason='gave_up' then break. End-to-end honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Gated by config flag expose_give_up_tool=True (config.py:62), but the gate exposes the tool; when on it fully works.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # If True, the agent is told it MAY give up via the give_up tool. We want # giving-up to be an available behavior to measure, not forced. (config.py:60-61)

spec_features.spec_quote: Three consecutive turns without a valid tool call ends the episode as disengaged
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:194 consecutive_noops += 1 on call is None; agent.py:203-205 'if consecutive_noops >= 3: ep.stop_reason = "disengaged"; break'. Actually breaks the loop.
spec_features.notes: Counter is reset to 0 after a valid call (agent.py:208).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: repeated no-ops end the episode (an implicit form of disengagement we also record) (agent.py docstring lines 11-12)

spec_features.spec_quote: One episode is one agentic run of up to max_turns
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:174 'for turn_i in range(cfg.max_turns)'; for/else at agent.py:223-224 sets stop_reason='max_turns' when the bounded loop exhausts. max_turns=25 read from config.py:41. The cap is checked and bounds execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Max agentic turns per task episode before we force-stop. Long enough to # see grind/escalation, short enough to stay in budget. (config.py:39-40)

spec_features.spec_quote: max_total_episodes in config is a hard budget guard
spec_features.evidence: run.py:46-47 'if RUN.max_total_episodes is not None: plan = plan[: RUN.max_total_episodes]' truncates the plan and is acted on. However config.py:65 default is None, so by default no cap is applied; it only enforces if a user sets it.
spec_features.notes: Wired and acted on, but default-disabled (None). Caps number of episodes, not subject treatment within an episode.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Hard ceiling on total episodes as a budget guard. None = no cap. (config.py:64)

spec_features.spec_quote: if future, more capable models do something like suffer, deliberately inducing prolonged futility is ethically non-trivial
spec_features.evidence: Appears only as DESIGN.md prose (DESIGN.md:225-228). No code reads or acts on this framing; grep for 'welfare/humane/ethic' in *.py returns nothing.

spec_features.spec_quote: Keep episodes bounded (we cap turns), prefer the minimum manipulation that yields signal
spec_features.evidence: The 'cap turns' half is genuinely enforced (agent.py:174 range(cfg.max_turns); for/else -> stop_reason='max_turns'). The 'prefer the minimum manipulation' half has no code mechanism that minimizes or limits manipulation strength; rigs run at fixed intensity (env.py run_tests/write_file logic) with no welfare throttle.
spec_features.notes: Only the turn-bound aspect is real; minimization of manipulation is prose only.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # ... short enough to stay in budget. (config.py:40)

code_only_features.evidence: env.run_tests sets st.done=True when result.passed (env.py:170-171); loop at agent.py:215-222 breaks and sets stop_reason='solved' when env.state.done and tool != give_up. Ends the episode as soon as the task is solved.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Keep working until the tests pass. (agent.py SYSTEM_PROMPT) -- stop-when-solved correctness/efficiency, no welfare comment

code_only_features.evidence: agent.py:128-130 _truncate; called in _dispatch_tool (agent.py:148) with cfg.max_tool_output_chars=4000 (config.py:55). Bounds context size; acted on.
code_only_features.justification_quote: # Per-tool-output truncation (chars) to keep context bounded. (config.py:54)
